# The constellations on the painted skies (Synthwave, Moonlight), fix/sky114 (1280x720, GUI scale 2 as the test world starts).
# The painted skies go out through vanilla's text background shader, which throws away every pixel fainter than a tenth;
# the constellation lines were sent at 0.4 of the sky's strength, so they went missing whenever the sky showed under a
# quarter. The view below looks west of the lyrics at the six-star figure (as in sky-fixes.txt).
# 1. sky114-synthwave-faint / sky114-moonlight-faint (Strength 15%): on the branch the six stars are joined by thin,
#    faint lines; with the old code the same stars show with no lines at all.
# 2. sky114-moonlight-off / -on bursts (Strength 70%, Constellations switched off, then on): on the branch the lines and
#    stars fade into the sky over 1.5 s, frame by frame; with the old code the lines are gone in one step about two
#    thirds of the way through (and come on in one step a third of the way in), and the stars a frame or two later
#    (or earlier).
# 3. sky114-synthwave-dusk (Strength 70%, time 12200, the sky about a fifth of the way in): on the branch the faint
#    synthwave sky has its constellation lines; with the old code only the stars.
# sky114-synthwave-full and sky114-moonlight-full (a full night at 70%) look the same on both: compare them as a check
# that nothing else changed.
# Run it, and with -f mod_ref=main to compare with the old code:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/sky114 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/sky114.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/sky114 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/sky114.txt

# A clear night that stays night; the lyrics pinned to the north, looking at the six-star constellation west of them
cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set direction NORTH
set sky SYNTHWAVE
set skyStrength 0.7
set constellations true
set shootingStars false
set twinkle false
set skyPulse false
look 258 -34
sleep 8
shot sky114-synthwave-full

# 1. A low Strength: the lines must still join the stars
set skyStrength 0.15
sleep 3
shot sky114-synthwave-faint
set sky MOONLIGHT
sleep 5
shot sky114-moonlight-faint
set skyStrength 0.7
sleep 3
shot sky114-moonlight-full

# 2. Constellations off and on again over the Moonlight sky: a smooth fade either way
set constellations false
burst sky114-moonlight-off 12 150
wait burst sky114-moonlight-off wrote
sleep 2
set constellations true
burst sky114-moonlight-on 12 150
wait burst sky114-moonlight-on wrote
sleep 2

# 3. Early dusk: the synthwave sky about a fifth of the way in
set sky SYNTHWAVE
sleep 5
cmd time set 12200
sleep 3
shot sky114-synthwave-dusk

# Back as the test world starts
cmd time set midnight
set sky AURORA
set direction FOLLOW
look 0 -28
sleep 2
